product_launches.description: Docker is promoting its MCP Toolkit, MCP Catalog, Gateway, and Compose integration as a unified way to package and run MCP-compatible AI tool servers as containers with security and reproducibility for agentic AI workloads.

press_references.value: Docker Isn’t Just About Containers Anymore

product_launches.description: Docker has introduced Docker Model Runner, enabling developers to pull and run local AI models via an OpenAI-compatible API for prototyping on their own machines.

press_references.value: Run AI Agents Safely With Docker Sandboxes: A Complete Walkthrough

product_launches.description: Docker introduced Docker Sandboxes with a newly announced YOLO mode, a sandboxed environment and execution mode that lets AI coding agents run commands more freely while remaining isolated from the host machine.

press_references.value: Cagent: Dockers newest low code Agentic Platform

product_launches.description: Docker introduced Cagent, an open-source, low-code agentic platform that lets developers define and run AI agents via declarative YAML configurations, integrating with MCP and Docker Model Runner.

press_references.value: Docker Hardened Images for Container Security

product_launches.description: Docker is promoting its Docker Hardened Images (DHI) and associated hardened Helm charts as secure, minimal, production‑ready container base images and deployment artifacts aimed at improving container supply chain security.

press_references.value: Meet Docker’s Catalog of Verified MCP Servers for Cleaner Automation Flows

product_launches.description: Docker released a major MCP-focused update that introduces features such as an MCP Catalog of verified servers, an MCP Gateway, dynamic tool selection, Code Mode with sandboxed execution, and state persistence to streamline and secure AI automation workflows.

press_references.value: Docker Desktop Now Includes Its Own AI Tool: Ask Gordon

product_launches.description: Docker has launched a new AI tool called Ask Gordon within Docker Desktop, designed to help users streamline workflows, troubleshoot containers, and improve Dockerfile quality. The feature is currently in beta and free to use.

press_references.value: Docker Brings Agentic Apps to Life with New Compose Support, Cloud Offload, and Partner Integrations

product_launches.description: Docker launched major new capabilities for agentic applications, including extended Docker Compose support for agents and AI models, Docker Offload for cloud-scale execution, and integrations with leading cloud and AI platforms.

press_references.value: Docker Desktop app is now available on the Microsoft Store

product_launches.description: Docker has launched its Docker Desktop app on the Microsoft Store, enabling easier installation, updates, and enterprise management for Windows users.

press_references.value: Why Docker Scout Is Changing How Developers Scan for Vulnerabilities

product_launches.description: Docker Scout is a security tool for scanning vulnerabilities in containers, providing real-time insights and automated fixes.

overview_description.description: Docker helps millions of developers efficiently and collaboratively build, share, and run applications. The Docker collaborative application development platform provides developers with an unmatched experience for an integrated, reliable, and secure workflow—accelerating app delivery from code to the cloud. Through a combination of the world’s largest marketplace of trusted content and integrations with leading tools, Docker allows teams to rapidly create modern applications.

about_short_description.short_description: Docker’s platform helps millions of developers efficiently and collaboratively build, share, and run applications.

product.name: Docker Desktop
product.description: A desktop application for building, running, and managing containerized applications locally across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

product.name: Docker Hub
product.description: A cloud-based registry and collaboration platform for discovering, storing, sharing, and distributing container images.

product.name: Docker Hardened Images
product.description: A catalog of minimal, signed, and continuously patched container images designed for secure application development and deployment.

product.name: Docker Scout
product.description: A software supply chain security product that analyzes container images and dependencies to identify vulnerabilities and improve application security.

product.name: Docker Build Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based service for executing Docker image builds remotely, providing shared build infrastructure and scalable build performance.

product.name: Docker Sandboxes
product.description: An isolated execution environment that uses microVMs to run coding agents with restricted network and filesystem access.
